remarks: Your own 5-acre getaway awaits! Escape the hustle and bustle and enjoy the peace and privacy of this seasonal property featuring a cozy cabin, detached garage, and separate workshop shed. Whether you're looking for a weekend retreat, hunting camp, or a place to unwind and enjoy the outdoors, this property offers plenty of possibilities! The cabin features a metal roof, and the front porch was redone in 2022. The detached garage was built in 2015. With electric and water already on site, you can enjoy the convenience of existing utilities while embracing the charm of a rustic getaway. Even better, everything currently on site will stay, giving you a great head start on outfitting your own home away from home! Enjoy the quiet setting while still being conveniently located near local stores, restaurants, and everyday amenities. Property is being sold AS IS. All showings and property visits must be accompanied by a licensed real estate agent. Don't miss this opportunity to make your own little escape in a desirable seasonal location!
